tasks.label: Verificar: testes do Core (swiftc, sem Xcode)
Verificar: testes de lógica do App (swiftc, sem Xcode)
iOS: build para o Simulador
tasks.command: xcodebuild -project FinanceApp/FinanceApp.xcodeproj -scheme FinanceApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=${input:simulator}' -derivedDataPath build build

tasks.label: iOS: testes unitários e de UI (gera .xcresult)
tasks.command: rm -rf build/Test.xcresult && xcodebuild test -project FinanceApp/FinanceApp.xcodeproj -scheme FinanceApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=${input:simulator}' -derivedDataPath build -resultBundlePath build/Test.xcresult

tasks.label: Simulador: instalar e abrir o app com dados de demonstração
tasks.command: xcrun simctl install booted build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/FinanceApp.app && xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process booted com.example.financas -uiTesting -seedDemo -fixedToday 2026-10-19 -startScreen ${input:screen}

tasks.label: Simulador: captura de tela
tasks.command: mkdir -p Docs/screenshots && xcrun simctl io booted screenshot "Docs/screenshots/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).png" && echo 'Salvo em Docs/screenshots/'

tasks.label: Simulador: capturas completas (3 iPhones, claro/escuro, texto normal/grande)
Testes de UI: extrair capturas do .xcresult
